mood: Landscape photomontage: two unequal collage islands across quiet gray-blue space. A large detached black-rimmed mirror holds looping hair, cheek, suited shoulder and a glossy red cartoon-car sliver. Paired white dice hang beside it above a partial wheel and warm cigar-gripping fingers crossed by smoke. Apart, an upright black phone mass holds saturated green and jagged yellow-blue shapes.
material_language: Glossy mirror glass in thick rounded black molded plastic
Textured black wheel rubber beneath translucent gray-blue smoke
Warm photographic skin and a dark blunt cigar with a pale band
Low-resolution image fragments with abrupt seams and uneven sharpness
lighting: Keep mismatched photographic exposures: bright white dice, warm skin, glossy red highlights and cool smoke against black plastic.

negative_constraints: No dashboard reconstruction, complete pose, full cast or near-identical stacked driving scene.

No stretching, whole-image cropping, padding or pasted source panel to force landscape orientation.
No unrelated macro texture, room, landscape, skyline or polished product-photo replacement.
No identifiable portraits, target rings, pins, labels, debug marks, hotspot outlines or pasted cards.
Only the mirror glass is a planned source-bearing feature; supporting fragments are not additional windows or counted symbols.
